name: Augmented Exposure
summary: This app allows mental health professionals to measure negative emotional responses associated with emotional eating, body image disturbances and addiction-related cues. In eating disorders such as bulimia nervosa and binge eating disorder, emotional eating may contribute to binge episodes and loss of control. The application provides exposure to different virtual foods within two immersive environments, allowing patients to interact using hand tracking or controllers.
